recentItems.title: Doha Debates: What role should work play in our lives?
recentItems.description:
What role should work play in our lives?

In this episode of @DohaDebates host Mohamed Hassan is joined by Federico Campagna, Hoda Alkhzaimi, Yanis Varoufakis, and Robert Wolcott to debate what meaning we can expect from work in our lives. 

As technology transforms entire industries around the world, how will our relationships with work change, and who might get left behind?

recentItems.title: Israel outlawed Palestinian NGOs to silence civil society, human rights lawyer says
recentItems.description:
The Israeli military is carrying out a major operation in the occupied West Bank.
Soldiers are raiding several Palestinian non-governmental organisations (NGOs) in Ramallah. 
They have stormed the offices of the Union of Palestinian Women’s Committee and the Addameer Prisoner Support and Human Rights Association.
Files, documents and equipment have been confiscated. 
Israel classified these groups as “terrorist organisations” five years ago but the UN and EU dispute its evidence.

Muhammad Dahleh, Jerusalem-based human rights lawyer who's been practicing in the Israeli and Palestinian legal systems since 1993, tells Al Jazeera that Israeli military orders are used to outlaw Palestinian NGOs, restrict legal challenges and enable raids on their offices.

recentItems.title: AI floods Israel election campaign as Netanyahu’s Likud leads content push
recentItems.description:
Israeli political parties are increasingly using generative artificial intelligence in campaigning ahead of the October 27th elections.
One public monitoring tool has found nearly 14% of all Israeli election-related social media content was created or altered by AI.
And one political party is leading the pack in its use of what’s referred to as “synthetic content”.

Al Jazeera’s Michael Appel reports.
